items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04

ctx.x: oh, there's Danny Lewis, he would play bass with Frank Ducey, see, Frank Ducey, and then comes, uh, Jack Kerrig, he used to play with him, well, they had this little fella, they, he, he's a little sharp fella, they had, but he, he's still playing yet, and they call him, uh, Chester's artist,
